item.title: Experts warn western snowpack crisis signals a new climate reality for mountain towns
item.description: Across the Rockies and Intermountain West, conditions typically associated with peak winter never arrived. From Boulder to Park City, communities have experienced unusually warm temperatures, diminished snowfall, and widespread concern about the long-term viability of snow-dependent economies.
